result.claim: Diploid phasing of all 49 heterozygous SNVs recovered by minimum-error-correction of the 25 PacBio reads. Reads separate cleanly into two haplotype clusters (15 vs 10). Haplotype A carries the alternate allele (1) at 47 of 49 sites and the reference allele (0) only at V002 and V049; haplotype B is the exact complement. The bipartition costs 330 weighted mismatches (33 of 477 calls, ~6.9%), versus 1880 for an unphased consensus, so the two-haplotype model is strongly favored. V002, V048 and V049 are low-confidence.

payload.method_summary: Weighted Minimum Error Correction (MEC). Each read is assigned to one of two haplotypes (binary s_r) and each variant a haplotype-A allele h_V in {0,1}; a call's cost is its base quality when observed allele != predicted (h_V if read on A, 1-h_V if on B). Solved by alternating optimization (weighted majority vote for h given s; per-read best side given h) with 2000 random restarts. Global A/B swap is symmetric and scored identically. Uncertain = tied or <35% vote margin or coverage weight <=20.

result.method: Wrote /run/out/phase.py: load shared/observations.json, build (variant,allele,quality) per read, run weighted-MEC alternating minimization with 2000 random restarts (seed 1), keep min-cost bipartition. make_result.py assembles this manifest. Reproduce: python phase.py.
result.justification: Heterozygous SNVs on a diploid genome define two complementary haplotypes; noisy long reads should cluster by haplotype of origin. The MEC bipartition reduces weighted inconsistency from 1880 (single-consensus) to 330, i.e. it explains all but 6.9% of calls as sequencing error, matching PacBio error rates. Per-variant vote margins are large (>=50 weight) for 46 sites, giving confident phase; V002 (all reads report reference despite het genotype -> vote tie), V048 (small margin) and V049 (single read) are the only ambiguous positions.
unknowns: V002 shows 8/8 reads reporting the reference allele yet is annotated heterozygous; its true alternate-carrying haplotype cannot be determined from the public slice (assigned 0 by tie-break).
V049 has only a single covering read (weight 10); phase is essentially a guess.
V048 has a weak vote margin (20/60).
Absolute A-vs-B labeling is unidentifiable (global swap symmetry); only the bipartition is determined.
The held-out reference phase is unavailable, so accuracy cannot be self-scored.
